name: dac_assessment
description: CEQR Technical Manual Chapter 23 — Effects on Disadvantaged Communities. Determines if the project is within or within ½ mile of a NYS DAC under the Climate Act (EJSL, effective Dec 30 2024), screens CEQR technical areas for pollution burden relevance, and generates pre-populated EAF responses.

building_geojson.description: Project site boundary or building footprint. The centroid is used as the project location for DAC proximity analysis.

ceqr_technical_areas.description: CEQR technical areas with potential impacts, e.g. ["air_quality", "noise", "hazardous_materials"]. Used to screen which areas could create a disproportionate pollution burden on a DAC per ECL §8-0109.

buffer_distance_miles.description: Study area buffer radius in miles. Default 0.5 per CEQR Ch. 23 §320.

project_description.description: Brief description of proposed action for report context.

screening_determination.description: Proximity classification (within / proximate / outside DAC), assessment level required, and pre-populated EAF answers

dac_tracts_geojson.description: DAC census tracts within the study area, with burden and vulnerability indicators as properties

eaf_responses.description: Pre-populated Short EAF and Full EAF responses for DAC-related questions (per proposed amendments to 6 NYCRR Part 617)

screening_report.description: Narrative screening report for inclusion in EAS or EIS (CEQR Ch. 23 structure)

visualization.description: Interactive map showing project location, study area buffer, and DAC census tracts
